commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+6' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Betis will take a throw-in.
90+6' Romain Perraud (Betis) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+5' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.

67' The resulting corner from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Now Betis have a corner.
66' Hector Bellerin (Betis) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

65' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) receives a yellow card.

64' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Rui Silva dived superbly to block a header by Robert Navarro (Mallorca) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the right post, but Rui Silva pulled off a remarkable save!
63' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) sends a lovely cross into the penalty area and Robert Navarro attempts to score after getting on the end of it.
62' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 63:37.

58' The Betis players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
55' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Cyle Larin (Mallorca), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
53' Sergi Altimira (Betis) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
51' Vitor Roque (Betis) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Dominik Greif is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
49' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
48' Hector Bellerin (Betis) smashes the ball upfield and Abde Ezzalzouli brings it down with a fine first touch.

45+3' Good defending. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) tries to find Chimy Avila inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

45+1' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

40' Chimy Avila (Betis) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

35' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis), but referee Victor Garcia must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
34' Booking. Chimy Avila (Betis) receives a caution from the referee.
34' The referee raises a red card that points straight to Giovani Lo Celso (Betis), who has to leave the pitch.
33' A cross from a corner kick by Mallorca is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sergi Darder (Mallorca). The ball has crossed the sideline. Mallorca are taking a throw-in.
32' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Chimy Avila (Betis) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Mallorca earn a free kick.
29' Vitor Roque (Betis) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
29' Betis keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession. It's a throw-in for Mallorca.
25' The ball is out of play. Betis will take a throw-in.
24' Hector Bellerin (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement.
23' A header by Vitor Roque (Betis) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Dominik Greif, who makes a nice save.
23' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

23' Vitor Roque (Betis) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent. The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
21' Hector Bellerin (Betis) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
20' Samu Costa (Mallorca) jumps into a tackle and Victor Garcia signals a foul.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

17' Vitor Roque (Betis) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Dominik Greif anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the left side of the target. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.
14' Chimy Avila (Betis) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
12' Betis are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
8' 1 - 1 Goal! Cyle Larin plays a short, square pass into the path of Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:1. Fabulous goal!

7' 1 - 0 Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the ball on a solo run and smashes it from just outside the box. The effort goes into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper beaten. Absolutely fantastic!
6' Marc Roca (Betis) tries to find Hector Bellerin, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.
